honor_day_one_vote_body: Who made your game better? Honor that teammate for great shotcalling, having your back, or staying cool under pressure in a new honor ceremony after each game.
honor_day_one_rise_body: You begin at level two, and level up just by playing to win in matchmade games. At level three, receiving honor unlocks loading screen flairs.
honor_day_one_rewards_body: Earn all your key fragments by just getting games in and remaining honorable. After level 3, Honor Capsules drop at random and include a shot at exclusive rewards.
honor_late_recognition_team_choice_heade: You were the most honorable player from your previous game
honor_late_recognition_header_plural: Here are your honors from the previous game
honor_late_recognition_header: Here's your honor from the previous game
honor_celebration_unlock_0_body: You can finally level up in Honor again. Be careful, you’ll be back here pretty fast with dishonorable behavior.
honor_celebration_unlock_1_body: You can unlock loot and Honor rewards again. Stay cool.
honor_celebration_levelup_3_body: Congratulations! You're level 3. You can now earn loading screen flairs.
honor_celebration_levelup_4_body: Welcome to level 4. Your flair got an upgrade and so did your rewards!

honor_celebration_levelup_reclimb_2_clas: You made it back to level 2. You can now unlock better rewards!
honor_celebration_levelup_reclimb_3_body: You're back to level 3! You can earn loading screen flairs again.
honor_celebration_levelup_reclimb_4_body: Welcome back to level 4! Your flair got an upgrade and so did your rewards!
honor_celebration_levelup_reclimb_5_body: You're back to the highest honor level
